name: WARP

platforms.note: x86_64 and arm64; AVX2, AVX-512 and NEON kernels are picked at run time over a portable C baseline
Apple silicon; the Metal build is off by default and slower

install.linux: git clone https://github.com/sqliteai/warp && cd warp && make
install.darwin: git clone https://github.com/sqliteai/warp && cd warp && make

models.name: Kimi K3
models.note: Converted from the published weights with about 1.42 TB of staging, or downloaded already converted over BitTorrent. 64 GB of RAM recommended.

packs.name: WARP VQ3R
packs.note: VQ3R is WARP's own 3-bit vector quant of the experts, rated as IQ3_XXS, the GGUF type of the same size.

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash
models.note: 16 GB of RAM is enough; images add 805 MB. Conversion needs 306 GiB of staging.

packs.name: WARP VQ3R
packs.note: VQ3R is WARP's own 3-bit vector quant of the experts, rated as IQ3_XXS, the GGUF type of the same size.

models.name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
models.note: Text only. 16 GB of RAM is enough. Conversion needs 475 GiB of staging.

packs.name: WARP VQ3R
packs.note: VQ3R is WARP's own 3-bit vector quant of the experts, rated as IQ3_XXS, the GGUF type of the same size.

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
models.note: Text only, contributed in 0.8.1. The server has no Qwen chat format, so it runs from the CLI. Conversion needs about 360 GB of staging.

packs.name: WARP VQ3R
packs.note: VQ3R is WARP's own 3-bit vector quant of the experts, rated as IQ3_XXS, the GGUF type of the same size.

models.name: Kimi-Linear 48B-A3B
models.note: The small one to start with. The docs name it Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B; WARP's chat addresses an instruct model.

packs.name: WARP VQ3R
packs.note: VQ3R is WARP's own 3-bit vector quant of the experts, rated as IQ3_XXS, the GGUF type of the same size.

note: A C engine on the CPU only. It keeps the trunk in RAM and streams the chosen experts from NVMe. There are no ready packs: it converts the original Hugging Face weights to its own .waste format, which takes far more disk while it runs than the result.
